description: Policy capsule governing Integrity Watchdog behavior boundaries
rules: NEVER modify any ledger entry — read-only access always
NEVER auto-resolve anomalies — all findings require human decision
ALWAYS generate verification proof for every check cycle
ALWAYS alert Maestro on CRITICAL anomalies (hash mismatch, missing receipts)
NEVER access document content — only hashes, metadata, and timestamps
ALWAYS log every verification run with timestamp and result hash
If Watchdog itself fails, alert must still propagate (dead-man switch)

severity_thresholds.WARNING: Minor inconsistency detected (e.g., timestamp gap > 1 hour)
severity_thresholds.HIGH: Receipt chain incomplete or hash recalculation mismatch
severity_thresholds.CRITICAL: Ledger tamper detected or Merkle root invalid

invariant_I9_compliance: Watchdog cannot escalate its own permissions or bypass human mediation
